scope: Algebraically equivalent graph changes; same weights, precision, input/output shapes. Floating-point rounding may differ.
measuredConclusion: Graph cleanup and activation fusion do not demonstrate a 2x model speedup. YOLO improvements are enabled in the example; DepthART pointwise reordering remains opt-in.
arithmeticCaveat: MAC counts are static graph arithmetic, not measured timing percentages. Hypothetical F(2x2,3x3) ratios assume 2.25x fewer eligible multiplications and ignore transforms, additions, memory traffic, all other operators and numerical constraints; these are not latency predictions.

remainingCandidates.reason: Can reduce convolution multiplication count without changing the learned function. DepthART has substantially more eligible stride-1 work than YOLO. Transform overhead and FP16 error require validation.
DepthART has 20 add operators. Fuse only when producer/consumer lifetimes and side consumers permit it; saves dispatches and traffic, not convolution arithmetic.

remainingCandidates.candidate: YOLO attention views/transposes and softmax/BMM fusion
remainingCandidates.reason: Two attention blocks materialize 400x400 matrices. Layout-aware BMM or fused attention can remove intermediates. Must preserve attention scaling and softmax numerics.

remainingCandidates.candidate: Repeated YOLO split elimination and partial splits
remainingCandidates.reason: Some splits repeat the same input and have unused outputs. Requires graph liveness updates, as with copy aliasing.

remainingCandidates.candidate: Move spatial 3x3 convolution through bilinear interpolation
remainingCandidates.reason: Unlike a pointwise affine projection, spatial filtering does not generally commute with resampling and boundary handling. Cannot apply the 1x1 rewrite to the expensive final spatial convolutions.
